/*** StockMovDAO.getLotMasterInfoStockInCheck 재고이동,재고확인 바코드 조회***/
select b.barcode, b.itm_id, b.mov_qty as pda_qty, b.pda_fac, b.pda_wh, b.io_ty, b.src_no, b.src_sq, b.lot_no, (select itm_nm from dma100 a where a.itm_id = b.itm_id) as itm_nm, (select spec from dma100 a where a.itm_id = b.itm_id) as spec, (select fac_nm from bcc300 a where a.fac_cd = b.pda_fac) as fac_nm, (select wh_nm from bcw100 a where a.wh_cd = b.pda_wh) as wh_nm, isnull(min(t.pda_no),'') as be_pda_no, count(t.itm_id) as barcount from pda100 b left join pda100 t on b.itm_id = t.itm_id and t.mov_qty > 0 and t.src_ty <> 'PD100100' and substring(b.pda_no,2,6) > substring(t.pda_no,2,6) and b.pda_fac = t.pda_fac and b.pda_wh = t.pda_wh where b.barcode = #{barcode} and b.src_ty <> 'PD100100' and b.mov_qty > 0 group by b.barcode, b.itm_id, b.mov_qty , b.pda_fac, b.pda_wh, b.io_ty, b.src_no, b.src_sq, b.lot_no, b.itm_id
